# Lens & Latitude

> Documentary travel photography, slow-travel guides, cultural expeditions, and fine-art prints by Khilesh Sammal.

## Core Sections & Documentation
- [Destinations Directory](https://lensandlattitude.in/destinations): Comprehensive travel itineraries across Uttarakhand, Kerala, Punjab, Goa, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam.
- [Travel Journal & Blog](https://lensandlattitude.in/blog): Documentary field notes, packing checklists, food guides, and route logistics.
- [Patal Bhuvaneshwar Caves Guide](https://lensandlattitude.in/blog/patal-bhuvneswar-cave-secrets): Visitor guide to Uttarakhand's sacred subterranean limestone cave temple in Pithoragarh.
- [Nainital & Kumaon Lakes Itinerary](https://lensandlattitude.in/blog/nainital-heights-2025): 5-day mountain route covering Nainital, Bhimtal, Sattal, and local logistics.
- [Archival Print Store](https://lensandlattitude.in/shop): Museum-grade fine art photography prints on archival cotton rag paper.
- [About Khilesh Sammal](https://lensandlattitude.in/bio): Background, artistic philosophy, and commercial portfolio.
- [Editorial & Commercial Contact](https://lensandlattitude.in/contact): Inquiries for licensing, assignments, and collaborations.

## Policies & Compliance
- [Privacy Policy](https://lensandlattitude.in/privacy-policy): Privacy practices, cookies, and data processing.
- [Terms of Use](https://lensandlattitude.in/terms-of-use): Terms and conditions governing site access and content usage.
- [Shipping Policy](https://lensandlattitude.in/shipping-policy): Domestic and international print shipping timelines and packaging.
- [Return Policy](https://lensandlattitude.in/return-policy): Policies regarding order cancellations, returns, and damaged prints.
- [Disclaimer](https://lensandlattitude.in/disclaimer): Travel advice disclaimer and affiliate notice.
